summary: How to use Nightscout safely with AAPS: restrict access on the Nightscout site, choose in the NSClientV3 Synchronization settings whether AAPS uploads data and accepts changes from Nightscout, and set the Nightscout variables AAPS needs.

sections.heading: Security considerations
sections.summary: Nightscout can send commands to AAPS (temp targets, carbs), so the site should be secured.

sections.heading: Nightscout settings
sections.summary: On the Nightscout site: deny public access with authentication roles, share only readable tokens, and keep API_SECRET private.

sections.heading: AAPS settings
sections.summary: Opening the NSClientV3 Synchronization settings from Settings or from Configuration > Communication, and which upload and receive options to enable depending on whether Nightscout is the BG source.

sections.heading: Do not sync from Nightscout
sections.summary: Keeping all 'Receive … from NS' switches off in Synchronization so AAPS ignores changes made in Nightscout.

sections.heading: Accept changes from Nightscout
sections.summary: Turning the receive switches on so profile changes, temp targets and carbs entered in Nightscout are used by AAPS; insulin from Nightscout is only recorded.

sections.heading: Further security settings
sections.summary: Keep the phone updated, as described in the safety section.

sections.heading: Manual Nightscout setup
sections.summary: Nightscout site variables (ENABLE, DEVICESTATUS_ADVANCED, SHOW_FORECAST, pump fields and alarms, SHOW_PLUGINS) needed to show AAPS data; values in code are Nightscout configuration, not app labels.

sections.heading: Nightscout as a paid SaaS (Software as a Service)
sections.summary: With a hosted Nightscout, set the variables in the vendor's web interface.

manual_note: "Receive ... from NS" in 'Do not sync from Nightscout' stands for the whole group of receive switches (pref_title_ns_receive_*), not one label. The quoted "Do not bolus, record only" has no exact app string; the closest is bolus_recorded_only in core/interfaces.
